answer: Sybil resistance comes from registering each agent identity only after remote attestation proves an approved enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), then binding the identity to the attesting platform key and a freshness challenge. A copied VM cannot forge that hardware-rooted proof, so creating another identity requires access to another eligible silicon-backed platform, not mere duplication. The signal remains verifiable across the network horizon, even in a nebula of untrusted hosts.
